player.description: Athletic hobgoblin variant (wolf- and bear-touched), no tusks. Returned from cleared den with new weapons and supplies.

inventory.name: Hobgoblin Broad Cleaver
inventory.description: Thick-spined cleaver taken from the hobgoblin leader. Sharpened and maintained.

inventory.name: Human Short Sword
inventory.description: Well-made trophy short sword. Sharpened and maintained.

inventory.name: Patched Leather Satchel
contents: jewelry and trinkets (rings, silver pendant, glass beads)

inventory.name: Bag of Safe Food
inventory.description: Substantial dried/smoked meat, nuts, and roots from the den. Given to Elena for the house.

elena.notes: Has now seen the hobgoblin transformation. Received large food stores.

history: Cleared den, transformed, looted cleaver, short sword, food, coins and trinkets.
Returned home, gave food to Elena, saved new equipment.
